title: Fix Subscription Method & Add Ad Revenue Monetization

requirements.text: Fix the broken Stripe premium subscription flow end-to-end. The `createCheckoutSession` backend call must correctly generate a Stripe checkout URL. The `useCreateCheckoutSession` hook must properly redirect the user to the Stripe-hosted payment page. After payment, `PaymentSuccess.tsx` must verify the session and call `setSubscriptionStatus` to upgrade the user to premium. After payment failure/cancellation, `PaymentFailure.tsx` must allow the user to retry. The `useGetUserSubscriptionStatus` hook must reflect the correct tier ('free' or 'premium') from the backend at all times.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the subscribe/upgrade button on the Upgrade page initiates a Stripe checkout session and redirects to the Stripe payment page
After successful payment, the user is redirected to /payment-success, their subscription status is updated to premium, and a success message is shown
After cancelled/failed payment, the user is redirected to /payment-failure with a retry option
The Settings page correctly displays 'Premium' tier after a successful subscription
The UpgradePrompt component is hidden for users with an active premium subscription
The backend correctly stores and returns subscription status per user principal

requirements.text: Add an ad revenue system to the backend. Implement a data model to track ad impressions and revenue per video and per creator. Add backend endpoints: `recordAdImpression(videoId)` to log an ad view and accrue simulated revenue to the video uploader, `getAdRevenueForCaller()` to return the total ad revenue earned by the authenticated caller, and `getAdRevenueForVideo(videoId)` to return revenue for a specific video. Revenue should be calculated at a fixed simulated CPM rate (e.g., $2.00 per 1000 impressions).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes `recordAdImpression(videoId: Text) : async ()` that increments impression count and accrues revenue for the video owner
Backend exposes `getAdRevenueForCaller() : async Float` returning total earnings for the authenticated user
Backend exposes `getAdRevenueForVideo(videoId: Text) : async Float` returning earnings for a specific video
Revenue is computed at a fixed CPM rate applied to impression count
Ad impression data is persisted in stable storage

requirements.text: Add an ad revenue dashboard UI. Create a new 'Ad Revenue' section visible in the user's Profile page and/or Settings page for authenticated users. It must display: total ad earnings (fetched via `getAdRevenueForCaller()`), a per-video breakdown showing each video's title, total impressions, and estimated revenue. Simulate an ad impression by calling `recordAdImpression` when a video has been watched for at least 10 seconds on the VideoPlayer page.
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users see a 'Ad Revenue' card/section in their Profile or Settings page
Total earnings are displayed in USD with two decimal places
A per-video table/list shows video title, impression count, and estimated earnings
An ad impression is automatically recorded after 10 seconds of video playback on the VideoPlayer page
Revenue data refreshes when the user navigates to the earnings section
Non-authenticated users do not see the ad revenue section

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
All backend logic must remain in a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo
Ad revenue is simulated — no real ad network integration required
Stripe configuration (secret key, allowed countries) must remain configurable via the existing StripeSetupModal
nonGoals: Real ad network integration (Google AdSense, etc.)
Payout processing or real money transfers for ad revenue
Shorts features beyond the existing placeholder
